cited_refs.abstract: Online social media (OSM) communications sometimes turn into hate-filled and offensive comments or arguments. It not just disrupts the social fabric online, but also leads to hate, violence, and crime, in the real physical world in worst scenarios. The existing content moderation practices of OSM platforms often fail to control the online hate. In this article, we develop a deep learning model called BiCapsHate to detect hate speech (HS) in OSM posts. The model consists of five layers of deep neural networks.
